items.notes: Isolation invariants span the access paths a tenant move must coordinate, but the excerpt gives no migration or cutover steps.
Outbox and duplicate-side-effect material supports idempotency, but API behavior for key reuse with a changed payload is not established.
Page explicitly defers the generic effect-identity contract; periodic leases do not explain the local-record versus external-effect gap.
Effect-identity and deduplication scope directly covers the guarantees and limits that dedup-key expiry tests must probe.
Provenance subjects and component inventories do not address recovery point or recovery time objectives.
Disaster-recovery and restore contract scope directly covers why replica promotion cannot undo an accidental deletion.
PostgreSQL WAL/recovery chapter landing is relevant supporting, but a landing page does not itself list physical PITR artifacts.
Runtime diagnostic experiments target memory/GC/CPU observation, not parallel-call threshold probability.
ZGC workload case concerns JVM pause and latency tradeoffs, not hedged-read overload.
Finite-window and closed-loop measurement directly addresses why a closed load generator can mask overload.
